rules: No new media approved/published by this research pass.
Commons source-page rights are preliminary until exact original bytes and current creator/licence are corroborated; new WebPs require hashes and full-frame mobile assessment.
No invented or moved pins, no affiliation or Mass programme changes. Chapel site must be exact CL2/Excel-approved before its photograph can join a Directory venue.
Do not use unrelated same-town churches or erase photographed obstructions.

records.name: Our Lady of Lourdes and St Cecilia, Blandford Forum
records.editorial_assessment: Prominent parked white vehicle occupies archived first photograph foreground; Commons image (4) is a cleaner no-car exterior of the exact same church.
records.next_evidence: Acquire the full-resolution original, verify its SHA-1, compare the 320/390px full-frame hero, create a pinned WebP and EN/FR credit before proposing publication.

records.name: St Mary's Old Town Chapel, Park City
records.editorial_assessment: Parish confirms its Traditional Latin Mass is at the historic Old Town Chapel, 121 Park Avenue, while the source ID is broadly named St Mary Park City with source_marker_unassessed map pin 40.682044,-111.537095. The Commons photograph is the Old Chapel (camera 40.639991,-111.494950), not main church at 1505 White Pine Canyon Road. Map marker and chapel photograph are not exact-site reconciled.
records.next_evidence: Keep held. Reconcile distinct historic chapel as an exact physical site using the Excel Location Master/CL2 approval workflow; do not silently move the pin or use photo for parish-wide image.
